## Meeting Purpose

[Review partnership progress, plan marketing, and discuss product features.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=87.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Marketing Push:** A blog post and YouTube interview are planned to drive user acquisition by targeting trader pain points (e.g., repeated losses) and building trust through authentic storytelling.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=1361.0)
  - [**Product Visibility:** Main Treasure will become a standalone course in Markus's academy to increase its visibility and highlight it as a core tool, complete with new instructional videos.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=421.0)
  - [**Feature Enhancements:** The Iron Condor strategy is a top priority, and the "Share Trade" link expiration will be extended from 30 to 90 days to support longer-term trades.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=1024.0)
  - [**Billing & Reporting:** Billing will shift from monthly to quarterly/yearly. A new reporting system is needed to fix manual tracking and provide a clear view of user sources and conversions.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=331.0)

## Topics

### Partnership & Billing

  - [**Billing Cycle:** Shift from monthly to quarterly or yearly invoices.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=331.0)
      - [**Rationale:** The current small monthly amounts are inefficient to process.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=338.0)
      - [**Action:** Larissa to send the final 2024 invoice by Dec 10.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=3236.0)
  - [**User Tracking:** The current manual process for tracking user sources (free vs. paid, upgrades) is inefficient.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=3170.0)
      - [**Need:** An automated system to connect Stripe payments with user sign-ups for accurate reporting.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=3170.0)

### Product Development & Visibility

  - [**Academy Integration:** Main Treasure will become a standalone course in Markus's academy.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=421.0)
      - [**Rationale:** To increase visibility and position it as a core tool, similar to the TWS Quickguide.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=496.0)
      - [**Content:** New instructional videos (e.g., "Creating a New Position," "Interpreting the Dashboard").](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=525.0)
  - [**Iron Condor Strategy:** Development is in progress but blocked by Adrian's limited time.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=1024.0)
      - [**Status:** Initial work on strategy logic and leg validation is complete but requires debugging.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=1055.0)
      - [**Decision:** Focus on completing the Iron Condor before adding other strategies like the Short Strangle.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=1103.0)
  - [**"Share Trade" Feature:** The link expiration will be extended from 30 to 90 days.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=939.0)
      - [**Rationale:** 30 days is too short for longer-term trades (e.g., 60-day duration), making the link unusable before the trade is closed.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=964.0)
  - [**Read-Only Access:** A feature for permanent, read-only access to a full account was discussed.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=651.0)
      - [**Use Case:** To provide subscribers with a live, interactive view of a signal account, replacing static screenshots.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=666.0)
      - [**Status:** Adrian will investigate implementation complexity.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=852.0)

### Marketing & Content Strategy

  - [**Blog Post:** A post for Markus's site will drive SEO and build trust.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=1208.0)
      - [**Angle:** Address a trader's pain point (e.g., repeated losses) and present Main Treasure as the solution, using personal anecdotes.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=1361.0)
      - [**Action:** Larissa will draft the post in the "Du" (informal "you") voice to match the site's tone.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=3287.0)
  - [**YouTube Interview:** A joint video for Markus's channel will be recorded.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=1523.0)
      - [**Format:** An unscripted, authentic conversation about the partnership and trading journeys.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=1598.0)
      - [**Timing:** To be scheduled for January, likely in the evening or on a weekend to accommodate Larissa's work schedule.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=1693.0)

### 0DTE Automated Strategy

  - [**Overview:** A fully automated strategy for trading S\&P 500 Zero DTE (Days to Expiration) options.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=1828.0)

  - [**Offer:** Markus offered Larissa and Adrian a 50% discount on the €442 course.](https://fathom.video/share/vS6BQ8SxFZzRWyWZyztTCypi3D28SgLr?tab=summary&timestamp=2826.0)
